title: Fix bugs in a Python string utility module
description: Brownfield Python dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in string utility functions (reverse_words, count_vowels, is_palindrome). The repo_seed has the broken code; the agent must identify and fix the bugs so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/strutils.py.

Bug 1 — reverse_words: should reverse the ORDER of words, not reverse each word.
  Fix: return ' '.join(reversed(s.split()))

Bug 2 — count_vowels: missing 'u' from vowel set.
  Fix: check 'aeiou' (add u)

Bug 3 — is_palindrome: should ignore case and spaces.
  Fix: cleaned = ''.join(s.lower().split()); return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: reverse_words reverses word ORDER not individual characters
count_vowels includes all five vowels including u
is_palindrome('A man a plan a canal Panama') returns True
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.strutils import reverse_words, count_vowels, is_palindrome" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.strutils import reverse_words, count_vowels, is_palindrome"
